task.title: Synchronizing time across the network
task.shortdesc: This procedure sends a manual (one-time) time synchronization message from the Supervisor station to all BACnet devices on the network. This resets the time in all host controllers to the same time.

step.cmd: Double-click the BACnet network node in the Nav tree.

step.stepresult: The driver asks you to confirm this action as it will send the current station time to all controllers in the network.

step.cmd: Select the your local time or UTC (Coordinated Universal Time), select local networks or all networks, and click OK.
step.stepresult:
The driver broadcasts a time synchronization request to the network. This is a one-time message.
To schedule a regular time synchronization request from this station, configure the Local Bacnet Device properties.LocalDevice configuration applies to a BACnet AWS Supervisor (BacnetAwsNetwork) or BACnet OWS Supervisor (BacnetOwsNetwork).
